description.value: Dumpling King is an authentic Shanghai pot sticker restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, specializing in hand-made Shanghai-style pot stickers with thin wrappers, crisp bottoms, and abundant juices. The owner hand-grinds the meat and hand-rolls the wrappers himself, blending Shanghai and Northeastern Chinese dumpling traditions into a unique style. It offers counter-service takeout and online ordering for pickup, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor.
